Asha Rao: kicking off a small sprint to standardize contact normalization + dedupe rules for onboarding pipelines. noticed a bunch of near-duplicates slipping through and causing playbook double-fires.
Miguel Santos: +1. saw duplicate nurture emails in last week's cohort.
Priya Nair: do we have a single source of truth for canonical fields? org_id vs canonical_account_id is messy.
Sam Petrov: not really — two systems write canonical_account_id, plus the import job canonicalizes a different way.
Asha Rao: proposal: one lightweight runbook that: 1) canonicalizes name/address email; 2) computes a dedupe score; 3) emits a suppression tag if above threshold before playbook triggers. low-risk opt-in initially.
Miguel Santos: sounds right. can we sketch the heuristics? example rules to start with:
```
- Normalize: lowercase emails, strip punctuation from phone, collapse whitespace in names
- Canonicalization: prefer CRM canonical_id if present, fallback to hashed(email) + normalized name
- Dedupe score: join on (email exact) OR (phone exact) => score=100; else fuzzy(name+domain) weighted 0.7
- Suppression: score>=90 => tag:cs_auto_suppressed=true
```
Priya Nair: that fuzzy step needs thresholds. suggest we run sampled scoring job on last 30k contacts to get precision/recall.
Sam Petrov: I'll spin a quick query. thinking: run in staging, write tag to staging contacts, then replay playbook and measure double-fires.
Asha Rao: owners: Sam for staging job + sample run, Miguel to draft the runbook doc, Priya to define metrics (FP tolerance and recall target). I'll coordinate rollout and comms to enablement.
Miguel Santos: timeline?
Asha Rao: small pilot next week (Mon-Tue sample runs), validation Wed, soft opt-in on Thur for a subset of playbooks. full rollout after signoff.
Priya Nair: metrics I care about: duplicate playbook triggers per 1k accounts, missed-action rate (suppressed but should have fired), and runtime overhead.
Sam Petrov: query ETA EOD today; will post sample numbers.
CSBot: Reminder: retrospective for playbook double-fires scheduled in #cs-ops-retro on 1779200000.
Miguel Santos: quick Q — when suppressed, do we want a manual override flag for CS reps?
Asha Rao: yes. add `cs_manual_override=true` to allow reps to un-suppress for customer-specific actions. document in runbook.
Priya Nair: also add a note about GDPR opt-outs: suppression must respect consent flags, don't infer consent negatives.
Sam Petrov: posted sample run results: 30k contacts => 412 candidates score>=90, manual inspection of 50 sample pairs => ~94% true duplicates. posting CSV in #cs-data.
Asha Rao: nice. Miguel pls start runbook draft, include examples and the override flow. Priya pls draft evaluation checklist. Sam pls create a small PR that wires the suppression tag into staging playbook runner.
Miguel Santos: on it. will ping when draft ready for review. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: will prepare metrics dashboard tiles (duplicate triggers, suppression FN/FP).
Asha Rao: thanks all — will follow up with timeline and ship checklist.
Sam Petrov: ack.
